cause_quote: The new `message.isCollapsibleWork` branch called `work.append(message)` on whole non-final assistant messages, then returned them in a single `.completedWork` disclosure that started collapsed.
user_saw: When the final reply arrived, narration between tool calls disappeared from the chat transcript until the user expanded the Worked section.
summary: The fix keeps narration and media inline in source order, folds contiguous tool and reasoning activity into separate disclosures, and preserves their expanded state when older history loads.
reasoning: I checked the parent commit’s transcript and bubble rendering, which displayed assistant text inline even when the same message contained tool activity. PR #147540 first put those messages behind a collapsed disclosure on macOS, and PR #148002 subsequently enabled the same projection on iOS.
